decision_basis.athlete_clarification: Clayton considers Thursday's athlete-entered RPE 8 a controlled session rather than an overreach and notes that Garmin load 182.1 was only 7.1 above the written upper estimate.
decision_basis.coach_reassessment: RPE remains a real cost signal, but the 4.1-percent load exceedance is too small to operate as a standalone hard veto when stop rules were not triggered, posture and steering improved, and no fade was reported.
decision_basis.density: Friday must remain a genuinely low-cost continuity touch after Thursday's meaningful MTB session; it cannot become another attack, repeatability or setup-comparison day.
decision_basis.forward_calendar: Saturday is a full church day, Sunday is Sabbath, and 2026-08-03 through 2026-08-07 is a family trip to Sabah with no bike session currently planned.

supersedes.reason: HSC -1 next-day comparison would confound setup with fatigue and day order.
Mandatory rest treated small threshold exceedances too literally and did not incorporate the athlete's controlled-execution clarification or the approaching travel interruption.

session.title: Stumpjumper low-cost posture and visual-horizon continuity
session.purpose: Add one low-cost bike-specific touch before the church, Sabbath and Sabah interruption while consolidating Thursday's dynamically centred posture and moving visual processing one trail feature earlier.

dose.same_day_gate: Run the live Garmin decision sync, current_state and coach_packet before rollout. Require non-red physical readiness, CNS ready, normal illness status, clarity at least 8/10, leg and upper-body soreness no more than 3/10, and a clear bike inspection.
dose.setup: Keep fork HSC at Thursday's +1 position. Keep rebound, pressure, sag, shock, tyres, cockpit and cleats unchanged. This is not an A/B setup test.
dose.opening_gate: Ten to twelve minutes at RPE 2 with figure eights, symmetric steering, progressive front loading and the cue 'rear pressure, then immediately recenter.'
dose.climb: RPE 2-3. Brief natural standing is allowed where terrain asks for it, but there is no deliberate standing-torque dose.
dose.first_descent: One familiar 2K at 70-75 percent. Complete braking before the turn, identify the exit before the apex, and move the eyes to the next feature before brake release.
dose.optional_second_descent: A second 2K at the same or lower speed is earned only if the intervening climb remains RPE 3 or lower, vision and decision speed are unchanged, braking and upper-body fatigue are no more than 2/10, front tracking is fully intentional, and there is no urge to turn the ride into a speed test.
dose.egress: Use the easiest familiar exit at transport pace.
dose.hard_cap: Forty-five to seventy minutes, no more than two 2K descents. No 2K+, Pure Quill, Twin Peaks, standing-torque work, sprinting, jumps, setup change or segment chase.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: A short familiar MTB exposure should retain front-pressure authority, rapid recentering and earlier exit recognition without adding enough physiological or neural cost to impair the church day, Sabbath or travel recovery.
execution_rules: Speed is capped even if HSC +1 feels excellent; tomorrow does not validate maximum-speed chassis capacity.
Load the rear through timed leg and hip pressure rather than parking the torso behind the bottom bracket; return to centre before the next steering or impact demand.
The technical success marker is correctly anticipating every exit, not descending faster.
For a fed ride under 70 minutes, no honey is required. Bring 500-750 ml fluid and approximately 400-600 mg sodium total for actual Kuala Lumpur heat and sweat conditions.

expected_result.technical: Symmetric steering, stable front tracking, no missed exit, no reactive braking and unchanged decision speed from the first to final descent.
expected_result.physiology: Climbs remain RPE 2-3 and whole-session RPE 2-4, with no meaningful late high-intensity accumulation.
expected_result.week: Friday provides the final bike-specific bridge before Saturday church, Sunday Sabbath and the family-first Sabah week.

stop_rules: Red physical readiness, impaired or compromised CNS status, abnormal clarity, illness, soreness above 3/10 or any unresolved bike concern cancels MTB.

Any opening-gate left pull, steering asymmetry, front ping or harsh deflection, pack-down, rearward retreat, rear wallow/kick or chassis pitch removes the descent and ends the ride via the safest easy route.
Any missed line or exit, reactive braking, delayed decision, vision narrowing, braking or upper-body fatigue above 2/10, or climb above RPE 3 removes the optional second descent.
Do not upgrade because the first 2K feels effortless.
